statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service is to optimize rate control management
The patient has a diagnosis of I49.5
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
The insurer is the secondary payer
